newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Qingling down four pct on cash call fears.
newsitem.headline: Qingling down four pct on cash call fears.

text.p: Shares of Qingling Motors Co Ltd fell four percent or HK$0.125 to HK$2.925 in early trade on Friday on fears of a cash call and a share placement by Silver Grant International Industries Ltd, brokers said.
Investors used the cash call fears as an execuse to take profits since the counter had risen steeply earlier this week, Kinson Au, an analyst at PW Asia said.
China-based Qingling said it would decide by the end of the year on how to finance its new investment in pickup truck production, which would need an estimated 1.0-1.5 billion yuan.
